title: Custom Enchants
summary: **Custom Enchants** are enchantments the SMP adds on top of the vanilla ones: 141 of them, for weapons, armour, tools, hoes, fishing rods and two gear sets.

blocks.p: Most custom enchants are bought at the **Upgrade** bench in `/craft`. Put in a piece of gear, pick an enchant and buy its next level with Prism Shards and money. The bench sells each enchant up to the max level in the tables below.

ul: Random enchant books (Simple, Unique, Elite, Ultimate and Legendary) come from crates and the Battle Pass. Drag a book onto an item in your inventory to apply it.
A book can fail. A failed book is used up, but the item is never lost.
Chromatic gear comes with its Prism enchants already on it. Halloween gear has its own, from the retired Halloween Crate. The Upgrade bench does not sell those.
An item starts with 9 custom enchant slots.
Books do not combine. Two books of the same enchant, or a book on an item that already has it, will not raise the level. Levels come from the Upgrade bench and Awakening.
**Awakening** in `/craft` destroys one random upgrade on the item and pushes another one or two levels past its cap. You do not choose which.
The **Disenchant** bench in `/craft` takes one enchant of your choice off an item for 200 Prism Shards. The enchant is destroyed and nothing is refunded. Thorns and vanilla curses cannot come off.

blocks.p: These come built into Chromatic gear, from the Chroma Crate or the bench in `/craft`.
These are on Halloween gear, which came from the Halloween Crate. The crate is retired. Pieces players already own keep their enchants.

Confirm the live SMP runs this config before publishing.
